description: FORS2 is the FOcal Reducer and low-dispersion Spectrograph still offered on the VLT. These bands are its broad-band filters: Bessell I, the special R, and the high-throughput u, b, v and g set.
short_description: VLT FORS2 Bessell I, R_SPECIAL and high-throughput u/b/v/g filters
facility_description: The ESO Very Large Telescope stands at the Paranal Observatory in Chile.
notes: The ESO filter page says the HIGH curves are laboratory measurements bought in 2007 for FORS1, and it links the collimator scans used for b_HIGH, v_HIGH, R_SPECIAL and I_BESS. NJM's instrument note places this set in the current FORS2 configuration (manual P117, Table 2.1). Bessell 1990 applies to the filter ESO names BESS, not to R_SPECIAL or the HIGH set. No magnitude system is stated on the filter page. DetectorType is left unchanged; the manual describes a CCD.

I_BESS.Comments: ESO file I_BESS+77COLL_SR.ascii, linked from the FORS filter-curve page next to the BESS_I lab scan. Not Bessell's 1990 tabulated passband.

R_SPECIAL.Comments: ESO labels this SPECIAL_R and links R_SPECIAL+76COLL_SR.ascii. No photometric-system name is given beyond that label.

b_HIGH.Comments: ESO says u/b/v/g_HIGH were purchased in 2007 for the FORS1 blue-sensitive mosaic and that the tabulated curves are laboratory measurements. This band uses b_HIGH+113COLL_SR.ascii.

g_HIGH.Comments: Laboratory scan g_HIGH.txt. ESO says the HIGH-set curves are lab measurements and that new on-site measurements were still pending when the page was written.

u_HIGH.Comments: Laboratory scan u_HIGH.txt, part of the 2007 HIGH set described on the ESO filter page.

v_HIGH.Comments: ESO file v_HIGH+114COLL_SR.ascii, from the 2007 HIGH set.
